# Economic System Rework: Economic Spheres (generated by mod_tools/Wealth of Nations/sphere.py)

# Any scope, once a month, inside the World Economic League update.
won_sphere_tick = {
	# Reset
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_ready }
		clr_country_flag = won_sph_ovl
		clear_variable = won_sph_head
		set_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 0 }
		set_variable = { won_sph_p = 0 }
		set_variable = { won_sph_i = 0 }
		set_variable = { won_sph_cl = 0 }
		set_variable = { won_sph_out = 0 }
		set_variable = { won_sph_build = 0 }
		set_variable = { won_sph_trade = 0 }
		set_variable = { won_sph_res = 0 }
	}
	# Overlords: one pass over the subjects
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready is_subject = yes }
		OVERLORD = { set_country_flag = won_sph_ovl }
	}
	# Sphere leaders: faction leaders, and overlords outside any faction
	clear_array = global.won_sph_heads
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready has_capitulated = no OR = { is_faction_leader = yes AND = { is_in_faction = no is_subject = no has_country_flag = won_sph_ovl } } }
		add_to_array = { global.won_sph_heads = THIS }
		set_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_sph_kind = 2 }
		if = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes } set_variable = { won_sph_kind = 1 } }
	}
	# Members: the leader, its faction and its subjects; then subjects of members join their overlord's sphere
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_sph_heads
		every_country = {
			limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready OR = { tag = PREV is_in_faction_with = PREV is_subject_of = PREV } }
			set_variable = { won_sph_head = PREV }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready is_subject = yes NOT = { has_variable = won_sph_head } }
		OVERLORD = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head }
				set_temp_variable = { won_hh = won_sph_head }
				PREV = { set_variable = { won_sph_head = won_hh } }
			}
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready is_subject = yes NOT = { has_variable = won_sph_head } }
		OVERLORD = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head }
				set_temp_variable = { won_hh = won_sph_head }
				PREV = { set_variable = { won_sph_head = won_hh } }
			}
		}
	}
	# Totals, influence and the leader's choices, per sphere
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_sph_heads
		won_sphere_head_tick = yes
	}
	# The five most influential spheres
	clear_array = global.won_sp_rank
	set_variable = { global.won_sp_count = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = { array = global.won_sph_heads add_to_variable = { global.won_sp_count = 1 } }
	set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_sph_heads
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_sp_rank value = THIS } } check_variable = { var = won_sph_inf value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_sph_inf }
			set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.won_sp_rank = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_c0 = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_v0 = won_best }
		var:won_pick = { set_temp_variable = { won_t = won_sph_kind } }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_k0 = won_t }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { global.won_sp_k0 = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_sph_heads
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_sp_rank value = THIS } } check_variable = { var = won_sph_inf value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_sph_inf }
			set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.won_sp_rank = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_c1 = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_v1 = won_best }
		var:won_pick = { set_temp_variable = { won_t = won_sph_kind } }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_k1 = won_t }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { global.won_sp_k1 = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_sph_heads
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_sp_rank value = THIS } } check_variable = { var = won_sph_inf value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_sph_inf }
			set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.won_sp_rank = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_c2 = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_v2 = won_best }
		var:won_pick = { set_temp_variable = { won_t = won_sph_kind } }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_k2 = won_t }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { global.won_sp_k2 = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_sph_heads
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_sp_rank value = THIS } } check_variable = { var = won_sph_inf value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_sph_inf }
			set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.won_sp_rank = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_c3 = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_v3 = won_best }
		var:won_pick = { set_temp_variable = { won_t = won_sph_kind } }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_k3 = won_t }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { global.won_sp_k3 = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_sph_heads
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.won_sp_rank value = THIS } } check_variable = { var = won_sph_inf value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_sph_inf }
			set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
		add_to_array = { global.won_sp_rank = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_c4 = won_pick }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_v4 = won_best }
		var:won_pick = { set_temp_variable = { won_t = won_sph_kind } }
		set_variable = { global.won_sp_k4 = won_t }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { global.won_sp_k4 = 0 } }
	# Human players: their sphere's influence and rank, milestones
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.won_humans
		won_sphere_player_tick = yes
	}
}

# Sphere leader scope.
won_sphere_head_tick = {
	set_temp_variable = { won_hh = THIS }
	set_temp_variable = { won_sg = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_sf = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_sn = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_st = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { won_sg = won_gdp }
		add_to_temp_variable = { won_sf = num_of_civilian_factories }
		add_to_temp_variable = { won_sf = num_of_military_factories }
		add_to_temp_variable = { won_sn = 1 }
		# Economic ties inside the sphere: trade agreements and pacts count half (both sides list them), investments in full
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = won_trade
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { won_st = 0.5 }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = won_pacts
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { won_st = 0.5 }
			}
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = won_inv_who
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { won_st = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { won_sph_gdp = won_sg }
	set_variable = { won_sph_fact = won_sf }
	set_variable = { won_sph_n = won_sn }
	set_variable = { won_sph_ties = won_st }
	# Influence: world share (max 40) + ties (2.5 each, max 30) + members (3 per member beyond the leader, max 15)
	#            + directive (Cooperation 10, Balanced 5) + an Economic Minister (5)
	set_variable = { won_sph_share = won_sg }
	multiply_variable = { won_sph_share = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.won_world_gdp > 0 } } divide_variable = { won_sph_share = global.won_world_gdp } }
	set_variable = { won_sph_pt_share = won_sph_share }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_sph_pt_share max = 40 }
	set_variable = { won_sph_pt_ties = won_st }
	multiply_variable = { won_sph_pt_ties = 2.5 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_sph_pt_ties max = 30 }
	set_variable = { won_sph_pt_mem = won_sn }
	subtract_from_variable = { won_sph_pt_mem = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { won_sph_pt_mem = 3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_sph_pt_mem min = 0 max = 15 }
	# The AI leader picks its directive and minister
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		won_sphere_ai = yes
	}
	set_variable = { won_sph_pt_dir = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_dir = 1 } } set_variable = { won_sph_pt_dir = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_dir = 2 } } set_variable = { won_sph_pt_dir = 5 } }
	set_variable = { won_sph_pt_min = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_min > 0 } } set_variable = { won_sph_pt_min = 5 } }
	set_variable = { won_sph_inf = won_sph_pt_share }
	add_to_variable = { won_sph_inf = won_sph_pt_ties }
	add_to_variable = { won_sph_inf = won_sph_pt_mem }
	add_to_variable = { won_sph_inf = won_sph_pt_dir }
	add_to_variable = { won_sph_inf = won_sph_pt_min }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_sph_inf min = 0 max = 100 }
	# What every member gets (f = influence / 100)
	set_temp_variable = { won_f = won_sph_inf }
	divide_temp_variable = { won_f = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_bp = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_bi = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_bo = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_bb = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_bc = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_bt = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_br = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_dir = 1 } }
		# Cooperation: up to +8% productivity and -3 inflation; arms output -3%
		set_temp_variable = { won_bp = won_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { won_bp = 0.08 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_bi = won_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { won_bi = -3 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_bo = -0.03 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_dir = 3 } }
		# Rearmament: up to +6% arms output; -2% productivity and +0.5 inflation
		set_temp_variable = { won_bo = won_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { won_bo = 0.06 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_bp = -0.02 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_bi = 0.5 }
	}
	else = {
		# Balanced (and no directive yet): up to +4% productivity and -1.5 inflation
		set_temp_variable = { won_bp = won_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { won_bp = 0.04 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_bi = won_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { won_bi = -1.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_min = 1 } }
		# Industrialist: +4% construction, up to +10% with influence
		set_temp_variable = { won_bb = won_f }
		multiply_temp_variable = { won_bb = 0.06 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { won_bb = 0.04 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_min = 2 } }
		# Financier: +5 investment climate, -1 inflation
		set_temp_variable = { won_bc = 5 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { won_bi = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_min = 3 } }
		# Planner: trade agreements +10%, resource export earnings +25%
		set_temp_variable = { won_bt = 0.10 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_br = 0.25 }
	}
	set_variable = { won_sph_bp = won_bp }
	set_variable = { won_sph_bi = won_bi }
	set_variable = { won_sph_bo = won_bo }
	set_variable = { won_sph_bb = won_bb }
	set_variable = { won_sph_bc = won_bc }
	set_variable = { won_sph_bt = won_bt }
	set_variable = { won_sph_br = won_br }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } }
		set_variable = { won_sph_p = won_bp }
		set_variable = { won_sph_i = won_bi }
		set_variable = { won_sph_out = won_bo }
		set_variable = { won_sph_build = won_bb }
		set_variable = { won_sph_cl = won_bc }
		set_variable = { won_sph_trade = won_bt }
		set_variable = { won_sph_res = won_br }
	}
}

# AI sphere leaders: Rearmament at war, Balanced under high tension, otherwise Cooperation.
won_sphere_ai = {
	set_temp_variable = { won_want = 1 }
	if = { limit = { threat > 0.5 } set_temp_variable = { won_want = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { has_war = yes } set_temp_variable = { won_want = 3 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_dir_cd }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = won_sph_dir value = won_want compare = equals } }
		}
		set_variable = { won_sph_dir = won_want }
		set_country_flag = { flag = won_sph_dir_cd days = 90 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_min_cd } }
		set_temp_variable = { won_want = 1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_trade_count > 2 } } set_temp_variable = { won_want = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_inflation > 6 } } set_temp_variable = { won_want = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { var = won_sph_min value = won_want compare = equals } } }
			set_variable = { won_sph_min = won_want }
			set_country_flag = { flag = won_sph_min_cd days = 180 }
		}
	}
}

# Human player scope (monthly): influence for the faction-screen button, rank, milestones.
won_sphere_player_tick = {
	set_variable = { won_sp_my_inf = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_sp_my_rank = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_t = won_sph_inf } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_my_inf = won_t }
		set_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.won_sph_heads
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_sph_inf value = won_t compare = greater_than } } add_to_temp_variable = { won_r = 1 } }
		}
		set_variable = { won_sp_my_rank = won_r }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } check_variable = { won_sp_my_inf > 49 } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_m50 } }
			set_country_flag = won_sph_m50
			country_event = { id = won.250 days = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } check_variable = { won_sp_my_inf > 79 } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sph_m80 } }
			set_country_flag = won_sph_m80
			country_event = { id = won.251 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

won_sphere_open = {
	clr_country_flag = won_show_dash
	clr_country_flag = won_show_league
	clr_country_flag = won_show_race
	set_country_flag = won_show_sphere
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rank_gdp < 1 } }
		won_world_rank = yes
	}
	won_sphere_show = yes
}

# Copies the sphere into display variables (ROOT = the player). Only while the window is open.
won_sphere_show = {
	set_variable = { won_sp_on = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_sp_lead = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_sp_mn = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_sp_more = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head }
		set_variable = { won_sp_on = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_sp_hc = won_sph_head }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_sph_is_head = 1 } } set_variable = { won_sp_lead = 1 } }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c0 = won_sph_inf } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_inf = won_c0 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c1 = won_sph_kind } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_kind = won_c1 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c2 = won_sph_gdp } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_gdp = won_c2 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c3 = won_sph_fact } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_fact = won_c3 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c4 = won_sph_n } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_n = won_c4 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c5 = won_sph_ties } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_ties = won_c5 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c6 = won_sph_share } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_share = won_c6 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c7 = won_sph_pt_share } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_pt_share = won_c7 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c8 = won_sph_pt_ties } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_pt_ties = won_c8 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c9 = won_sph_pt_mem } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_pt_mem = won_c9 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c10 = won_sph_pt_dir } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_pt_dir = won_c10 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c11 = won_sph_pt_min } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_pt_min = won_c11 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c12 = won_sph_dir } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_dir = won_c12 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c13 = won_sph_min } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_min = won_c13 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c14 = won_sph_bp } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_bp = won_c14 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c15 = won_sph_bi } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_bi = won_c15 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c16 = won_sph_bo } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_bo = won_c16 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c17 = won_sph_bb } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_bb = won_c17 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c18 = won_sph_bc } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_bc = won_c18 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c19 = won_sph_bt } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_bt = won_c19 }
		var:won_sph_head = { set_temp_variable = { won_c20 = won_sph_br } }
		set_variable = { won_sp_br = won_c20 }
		# percentages for display
		multiply_variable = { won_sp_bp = 100 }
		multiply_variable = { won_sp_bo = 100 }
		multiply_variable = { won_sp_bb = 100 }
		multiply_variable = { won_sp_bt = 100 }
		multiply_variable = { won_sp_br = 100 }
		set_variable = { won_sp_frame = won_sp_inf }
		divide_variable = { won_sp_frame = 5 }
		add_to_variable = { won_sp_frame = 1 }
		round_variable = won_sp_frame
		clamp_variable = { var = won_sp_frame min = 1 max = 21 }
		# Members, largest first
		set_temp_variable = { won_hh = won_sph_head }
		set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sp_pk } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_gdp }
				set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
			var:won_pick = { set_country_flag = won_sp_pk }
			set_variable = { won_sp_c0 = won_pick }
			set_variable = { won_sp_v0 = won_best }
			add_to_variable = { won_sp_mn = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sp_pk } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_gdp }
				set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
			var:won_pick = { set_country_flag = won_sp_pk }
			set_variable = { won_sp_c1 = won_pick }
			set_variable = { won_sp_v1 = won_best }
			add_to_variable = { won_sp_mn = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sp_pk } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_gdp }
				set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
			var:won_pick = { set_country_flag = won_sp_pk }
			set_variable = { won_sp_c2 = won_pick }
			set_variable = { won_sp_v2 = won_best }
			add_to_variable = { won_sp_mn = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sp_pk } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_gdp }
				set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
			var:won_pick = { set_country_flag = won_sp_pk }
			set_variable = { won_sp_c3 = won_pick }
			set_variable = { won_sp_v3 = won_best }
			add_to_variable = { won_sp_mn = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sp_pk } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_gdp }
				set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
			var:won_pick = { set_country_flag = won_sp_pk }
			set_variable = { won_sp_c4 = won_pick }
			set_variable = { won_sp_v4 = won_best }
			add_to_variable = { won_sp_mn = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_best = -1 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_variable = won_sph_head check_variable = { var = won_sph_head value = won_hh compare = equals } NOT = { has_country_flag = won_sp_pk } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { var = won_gdp value = won_best compare = greater_than } }
				set_temp_variable = { won_best = won_gdp }
				set_temp_variable = { won_pick = THIS }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_best > -1 } }
			var:won_pick = { set_country_flag = won_sp_pk }
			set_variable = { won_sp_c5 = won_pick }
			set_variable = { won_sp_v5 = won_best }
			add_to_variable = { won_sp_mn = 1 }
		}
		every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = won_sp_pk } clr_country_flag = won_sp_pk }
		set_variable = { won_sp_more = won_sp_n }
		subtract_from_variable = { won_sp_more = won_sp_mn }
	}
	add_to_variable = { won_sp_dirty = 1 }
}

	set_variable = { won_sph_dir = 1 }

}
